profile.visual_desc: Human rider in blue plate armor with gold trim and a flowing red cape. He mounts a brown dragon with large leathery wings and a thick tail. The rider has a muscular build and spiky brown hair.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up of a determined man facing left. Features sharp eyes, a blue headband over spiky brown hair, and a stoic, focused expression.
profile.weapon_desc: A large silver-headed poleaxe held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view. The rider sits upright on the dragon, holding the poleaxe vertically. The dragon's wings are partially spread.
profile.step2_windup: The rider leans back, hoisting the poleaxe over his shoulder. The dragon tenses its body, preparing to lung forward.
profile.step3_impact: A forceful downward swing toward the top-left. A wide, bright golden energy beam arcs diagonally across the frame.
profile.step4_finish: The rider completes the arc as the red cape billows forward. The dragon stabilizes while the golden slash trail fades away.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 follows the diagonal trajectory of the poleaxe swing from bottom-right toward the top-left target area.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains structural integrity and aligns with reference VFX timing and orientation.
